name: The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali
insider_take: This isn't just another beachfront resort – it's Bali's original luxury beach destination that pioneered the exclusive Nusa Dua enclave.
whats_special: The Westin Nusa Dua sits on pristine white sand beaches within the BTDC (Bali Tourism Development Corporation) area, Indonesia's first planned resort destination. The property features traditional Balinese architecture with soaring alang-alang thatched roofs and overlooks the Indian Ocean. It's also home to one of Bali's most Instagram-worthy infinity pools that seemingly blends into the ocean horizon.
pro_tip: Book an ocean-facing room on floors 3-4 for the perfect balance of sea views and easy beach access. The resort's location means you're walking distance to the Bali Collection shopping center and just minutes from the sacred Pura Geger Temple perched on limestone cliffs.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Heavenly Spa treatments incorporating traditional Balinese healing rituals, and sunset cocktails at the beachfront Ikan Restaurant. The nearby Geger Beach offers some of Bali's calmest waters, perfect for swimming year-round, while the Bali National Golf Club – designed by Robin Nelson and Rodney Wright – is considered one of Asia's most challenging coastal courses.
pros: Prime beachfront location on pristine white sand Nusa Dua Beach
Signature Westin Heavenly Bed and wellness-focused amenities
Multiple dining venues including authentic Balinese and international cuisine
Comprehensive spa services and lagoon-style swimming pools
cons: Large resort property may require walking distances between facilities
